اقتصدن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَدْنَ (iqtaṣadna) /iq.ta.sˤad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اُقْتُصِدْنَ (uqtuṣidna) /uq.tu.sˤid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اِقْتَصِدْنَ (iqtaṣidna) /iq.ta.sˤid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
